### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or shortcut you are proposing.

### Proposed Unicode Symbol / Mapping
- Shortcut: `//...`
- Resulting Unicode Symbol: (e.g. `ℏ`, `⊕`, `⨂`)
- Domain: (e.g. Linear Algebra, Quantum Mechanics, Logic)

### Out-of-Scope Reminder
> **Note**: This project strictly outputs copy-pasteable **Unicode** text. Requests for LaTeX-syntax generation (`\frac{a}{b}`, `\int`, etc.) are out of scope, as specialized LaTeX editors already provide native math modes.
